title: local-workflow ship resolves the repository slug from the origin URL so its commit statuses post from REST-only hosts
goal: ship posts its four susi-local/* commit statuses with `gh api repos/{slug}/statuses/{sha}` (REST), but resolved the slug with `gh repo view --json nameWithOwner`, a GraphQL query that a cloud session's GitHub proxy refuses; every status of the v0.21.52 and commercial v3.1.3 ships went unposted. Read owner/name from `git remote get-url origin` instead, accepting the https (with or without credentials), ssh:// and scp-like github.com spellings and refusing other hosts and shapes, with the same owner/name character validation as before.
